title: potentilla glandulosa subsp. reflexa
intro: Potentilla glandulosa subsp. reflexa, commonly known as the Five-fingered Potentilla, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to the western United States. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla glandulosa subsp. reflexa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. Further research is necessary to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant and to isolate and characterize its active compounds.
